entities.name: Claude François Ferey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Claude François Ferey, baron de Rozengath was a French Army officer who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. During the War of the First Coalition, he fought in the siege of Mainz and the War in the Vendée. After being promoted to command an infantry regiment, he led his unit at the battles of Neuwied, Montebello, and Marengo.
